Physical therapy helps people of all ages who have medical conditions, illnesses or injuries that limit their regular ability to move and function.

#A customized physiotherapy program at @rehabit_centre can help individuals return to their prior level of functioning, and encourage activities and lifestyle changes that can help prevent further injury and improve overall health and well being.

=As the awareness is increasing day by day, patients these days are going directly to the physiotherapist at the first sign of a pain or injury, since it is considered a conservative approach to managing problems.
It helps in:
• Reduce or eliminate pain
• Avoid surgery (depending upon grade*)
• Improve mobility
•Recover from a stroke
• Recover from or prevent a sports injury
• Improve your balance and prevent falls
• Manage diabetes and vascular conditions.(through exercises)
• Manage age-related issues
•Manage heart and lung disease.(rehabilitation)
• Manage Women’s Health and other conditions!
